headline: Gentle AI can review this change before you call it done.
reason: Review can help detect execution issues in these changes.

choices.label: Review this change
choices.effect: Reviews only this change; later medium- or high-risk changes ask again, and delivery needs separate approval.
choices.invocation: gentle-ai review start --contract gentle-ai.review-integration/v2 --cwd /home/ubuntu/orca/workspaces/orca-openbot/grace-stalled --target sha256:cc2cc5aa7a3271392e1196f90b65617281d0fe747f1cafe4143da76d9d34fd59 --target-evidence v1:base-diff:workspace:c6908c3b172e354724d0b24db8597feaded53bbd:a2e21425c65f79b9c6e0658fd4d79304ecef72e5:sha256:08cb96edd53fb89440e5a8fcb205bc7f775627220e617dac1b558dd43852fea0 --projection workspace --agent pi --lineage review-0a6ea52896442898 --base-ref c6908c3b172e354724d0b24db8597feaded53bbd --committed-only --lenses review-risk,review-resilience,review-reliability --lenses-reason 'Added events-full.jsonl persisting full redacted payloads (new stored data, secrets redaction, size rotation); heartbeat-triggered ingest spawn, stalled.lock and best-effort logging (failure and concurrency behavior); new stall/turn-open logic in the bridge reader that tests should pin.' --consent granted

choices.label: Skip this time
choices.effect: Skips only this change; no review record is created, and future reviews stay enabled.
